skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the Objectives and Research Methods of Ho Chi Minh Thought Studies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the research objectives, methods, and significance of studying Ho Chi Minh thought.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing the Formation and Development Process of Ho Chi Minh Thought
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze the formation and development process of Ho Chi Minh thought.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Recognizing the Scientific and Revolutionary Nature of Ho Chi Minh Thought
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will recognize the scientific and revolutionary nature of Ho Chi Minh thought.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying Ho Chi Minh Thought on Independence and Socialism
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply Ho Chi Minh thought on independence and socialism in current reform practices.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Ho Chi Minh Thought on Party and State
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will analyze Ho Chi Minh thought on party and state in the context of socialist construction.
Students will enhance their logical reasoning skills and strengthen their political resolve.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Developing Professional Responsibility and Communication Skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will develop professional responsibility and communication skills to meet modern requirements.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the Core Concepts of Ho Chi Minh Thought
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the core concepts of Ho Chi Minh thought.
